app_store.name: StudioFlat
app_store.subtitle: Book class. Keep the fee.
app_store.promotional_text: Schedule, packs, and waitlists for one studio. Your Stripe account takes the card. We add $0.
app_store.description:
StudioFlat is class booking for a small studio.

Publish the week. A member reserves a drop-in from the phone without creating an account. Packs and memberships expire on a date you set. A full class keeps a waitlist and offers the next person a limited time to claim.

You connect your own Stripe account. StudioFlat does not add a platform fee on the payment.

Micro is $29 a month for a solo instructor. Studio is $49 a month. Annual billing includes two months free.

The member schedule can be installed from the browser. This version does not include a separate branded app store app.
app_store.whats_new: First release. Schedule, passes, waitlist, and a flat monthly price.
